title: Dentacor — Informed Consent Disclosing Absence Of Dentist
content: During the initial Dentacor RMA term, a Dentacor-employed hygienist had to obtain patient informed consent before any RMA-authorized procedure, explicitly disclosing the absence of dentist supervision and the hygienist's narrower training and scope. The requirement expired with the initial mitigation period on May 31, 2026; no public extension instrument was located as of July 25, 2026.
